note: Raad, Lahav & Vafeiadis (VMCAI 2019) give SI two timestamp-free lock-based (MRSW) reference implementations built on the release-acquire (RA) fragment of C/C++11, proved sound and complete against the declarative SI specification (and likewise Robust SI). Retargeted from RC11 onto RA in 1.4.1: the target has always been the release-acquire fragment, as this note already said, and RA became a node in 1.4.0.
